verdict.rationale: Factory provides usage visibility via Settings > Usage and the `/limits` command, plus admin-level adoption/consumption tracking per developer and team (factory-docs-27, factory-docs-29). However, there is no evidence of an interface for actively setting or adjusting daily task/concurrency limits by plan tier — only monitoring is documented. Missing for 10: documented admin controls to configure/change plan-based limits, evidence of concurrency-limit enforcement mechanics, and independent confirmation of manage capability beyond viewing.
